title: ViralLensDiscoveryCandidateSchema
description: Formal JSON schema defining canonical Instagram discovery candidates and telemetry in ViralLens AI.

reel_id.description: Standard alphanumeric Instagram shortcode / Reel identifier (e.g. C2_vRNYhykr). Never contains query params.

reel_url.description: Canonical Instagram Reel URL in the format https://www.instagram.com/reel/{shortcode}/.

creator.description: Instagram creator username or null if unavailable. Never inferred or fabricated.

caption.description: Reel post caption or null if unavailable.

reach.description: Genuine video plays or views count as positive integer. Strictly null if unavailable (never 0, never synthetic).

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp or unix epoch string of Reel publication. Never inferred.

media_url.description: Direct MP4 download URL or null if provider does not legitimately expose it. Never fabricated.

source_provider.description: The provider that originally discovered this candidate.

source_query.description: The search query that returned this candidate.

metadata_completeness.description: Calculated completeness score [0.0 - 1.0] across canonical fields.

raw_provenance.description: Raw provider responses, merged source_providers, source_queries, and secondary engagement metrics.
